about: CookieConsent — the banner that asks whether non-essential cookies may be set, before any are. A region named by its heading, with the message, a link to the cookie policy and three actions: Accept al

title.about: The heading: what this is about, in a few words. Name the site when it helps ("Cookies on Example Store"). It names the region too, and it stays through the confirmation, so the region keeps its name

headingLevel.about: The heading's level in the page outline. Default 2.

children.default: "We use some essential cookies to make this site work. We'd
children.about: The message: which cookies are essential, which are not, and what the non-essential ones are for. Two short sentences; the policy has the rest.

policyHref.about: Where the cookie policy is. Without it there is no policy link.

policyLabel.about: The policy link's words. Default "Read the cookie policy".

settingsHref.about: Where the cookie settings are, when they are a page of their own. With it, "Cookie settings" is a link that works without script, and the confirmation offers a way back to it. Without it, it is a butt

acceptLabel.about: The accept button's words. Default "Accept all".

rejectLabel.about: The reject button's words. Default "Reject non-essential".

settingsLabel.about: The settings action's words. Default "Cookie settings".

hideLabel.about: The words on the button that hides the confirmation. Default "Hide this message".

onAccept.about: Called when they accept. Set the cookies and record the choice here: the banner stores nothing itself. Unmount it here to skip the confirmation.

onReject.about: Called when they reject non-essential cookies. As `onAccept`, the host records it.

onSettings.about: Called by the settings button (not when `settingsHref` makes it a link): open the settings.

onHide.about: Called when the confirmation is hidden, after the banner has gone.

choice.about: The choice, when the host already knows it: shows the confirmation instead of the question. Left out, the banner keeps track of the choice made in it, until it is hidden.

acceptedMessage.about: The line after accepting. Default: "You've accepted all cookies." plus the way back to the settings.

rejectedMessage.about: The line after rejecting. Default: "You've rejected non-essential cookies." plus the way back to the settings.

position.about: Which edge of the viewport it is fixed to. Default bottom. Ignored when `contained`.

contained.about: In the flow of the page instead of fixed to the viewport: for docs, stories, and a settings page that shows the banner in place.
